name: Kyber Cursor
author: s3pp3ku
description: A glowing blade-and-hilt mouse pointer in your theme's accent color that ignites when you hold a button: glow, crossguard beams, a drag trail and optional sounds.

barWidget.description: Sound, trail and glow color for the Kyber cursor. Click to change the options.

schema.label: Glow color
schema.description: A hex color such as #ff7a00. Leave blank to follow the theme accent.

schema.label: Sound
schema.description: all: ignite and off sounds; ignite: ignite only; mute: no sound.
